title: You Can't Teach Love
description: When publicist, Elizabeth, finds herself unexpectedly caring for her niece for a few weeks, she struggles to balance it all and finds unforeseen support from her niece's kindergarten teacher, Jamie.

title: Beauty and the Billionaire
description: Addison gets roped into traveling overseas with her brother and his picky billionaire boss. It's a world she doesn't understand, but she tries her hardest to help, if only to save her brother's job.

title: Heartland
description: Lou takes charge of the preparations for the big day; in an attempt to avoid the craziness, Amy tries to domesticate a rescued horse.

title: Heartland
description: Lou deals with last minute obstacles in an attempt to give Amy and Ty the perfect wedding.

title: The Shunning
description: Katie has always felt something missing in her simple Amish existence until an "Englisher" comes looking for the girl she gave up for adoption years ago.

title: The Confession
description: Hoping to inherit his dying wife's estate, a man hatches a plan and hires an actress to pose as her long-lost daughter.

title: Sugarcreek Amish Mysteries: Blessings in Disguise
description: After Cheryl's three-year engagement ends in a devastating breakup, her life is turned upside down when her aunt offers her an escape from Chicago to the Amish town of Sugarcreek. Struggling with being a fish out of water, Cheryl uncovers an unsettling secret that could disrupt the small town of Ohio. As Cheryl begins to solve the mystery, she finds community, belonging and the potential of new love.

title: Morning Show Mystery: Mortal Mishaps
description: Billie Blessings has gone from beloved chef, restaurant owner and morning show segment host to the prime suspect in a murder case when one of the executives at the network dies from poisoning.

title: Morning Show Mysteries: Murder on the Menu
description: Beloved cooking show host Billie Blessings finds herself in hot water when a dead body turns up in the car of one of her guests.

title: Morning Show Mysteries: A Murder in Mind
description: Cookbook author Billie Blessings is excited when friend Katie Sanders appears as a guest host on her show, but being a TV star can't save Katie from falling under suspicion of murder.

title: Morning Show Mysteries: Countdown to Murder
description: The murder of a supermarket owner puts TV chef Billie Blessings and Detective Ian Jackson on the trail of a possible serial killer.

title: Morning Show Mysteries: Death by Design
description: A woman's twin sister is found strangled to death.

title: Morning Show Mysteries: Murder Ever After
description: TV host Billie Blessings finds bones in the basement of an old friend's house, unearthing a dark secret that threatens to unravel the lives of the most powerful people in the city.

title: Blessings in Disguise
description: Katie, a driven New York fashion designer with only three weeks to develop a collection that could launch her brand to national prominence. Katie reconnects with Luke, her first love and now a gifted furniture designer and woodworker whose designs are rooted in craftmanship, patience, and purpose. As their lives intertwine once more, the two discover that inspiration is not found in deadlines or demand - but in the timeless values of home, heritage, and hope.

title: Roadhouse Romance
description: Lt. Callie Jackson returns home after a military tour to find her late grandfather's barbecue joint is struggling, but she has a run-in with a TV director who teaches her that sometimes it's best to look forward instead of looking back.

title: Color My World With Love
description: A woman worries that her daughter and her fiancé -- both having Down syndrome -- are not ready for marriage.

title: Sister Dating Swap
description: When sisters Helena and Rachel are fed up with their lives, they agree to swap homes for two weeks. What starts out as a holiday grows into a whole new perspective on their careers, lives and romantic relationships.
